name: art-theory-fundamentals
description: Art Theory Fundamentals: what kind of claim art theory actually makes, the formal elements, value, colour, composition, pictorial space, medium and materiality, the philosophical questions, beauty and the sublime, taste and judgement, theories of art and the definition problem, art and ethics, a historical skeleton from modernism to contemporary, the canon problem, iconography and iconology, semiotics, critical lenses, intention and the author, how to actually look at a work, and the art world and market.
